🎵 **Falak Dekhun | 4K Video Song | Garam Masala | Akshay Kumar, John Abraham | Sonu Nigam | Pritam**

Relive the magic of **“Falak Dekhun”** from the superhit Bollywood comedy **Garam Masala**, starring **Akshay Kumar and John Abraham**. ❤️🎶

Sung melodiously by **Sonu Nigam**, with music composed by **Pritam**, this romantic track is a perfect blend of soulful vocals, beautiful melodies and classic Bollywood romance.

✨ Watch **Falak Dekhun** in stunning **4K quality** and enjoy this evergreen Bollywood favourite all over again!
